issues.on_page: Property taxes 564,225; p11 shows General Fund property 509,916 + Streets 11,093 + Wheel tax 12,695 = 533,704 = p4 General Fund Property taxes
issues.issue: The statement's Property taxes line seems to include wheel tax 12,695 (motor vehicle). It can't be split exactly (p11 Total column prints property 521,008, which is 1 off), so as-printed is defensible.

The page doesn't say this is interest or fees. Treating it as interest is an assumption; 'debt service (principal and interest combined)' or Debt Service with no part would be closer to what is printed (same for detail[82]).
This cost-type line uses the function name 'utilities' as its category, so it can't be told apart from the function lines; a cost-type name such as 'Utilities (Power, Gas, Phone)' may be intended.

Streets property taxes reads as 11,093, but the printed Total column property 521,008 (509,916 + 11,092) and the Streets total revenues 215,032 both imply 11,092. Already listed as a report rounding gap in report_discrepancies; the digit should be confirmed in the source PDF.
